notes.title: Update 1.0.1 now live
notes.notes:
Dear players,



We’ve just released Update 1.0.1, addressing several issues reported after launch:



Fixed:

Dying right after completing the sword caused it to malfunction.

Clicking the exit door of the final maze repeatedly and too quickly could block item interaction.

In one of the dreams, climbing on certain boxes could prevent the player from moving.

Some text spacing adjustments were made.





As you play FoMO, if you encounter any bugs, issues, or simply want to share feedback with us, please let us know in the Steam discussions.



See you all again soon — we hope you’re enjoying the game!



FoMO Dev Team

notes.title: FoMO is here + Release Stream
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,



Tonight we’re going live with a special gameplay stream.

And yes, it’s hard mode.



FoMO is officially available on Steam.

Now you can get lost in the dark halls, make choices that change everything, and try to survive the monsters.

Expect tension, random mazes, and full-on horror.



📅 Today, July 21st, at 8:30 PM (GMT-3)



See you soon,

FoMO Dev Team

notes.title: FoMO Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,



The wait is almost over. We’re ready.
On July 21st, FoMO will be fully released on Steam.



You’ve seen a glimpse in the demo.
Now it’s time to face everything the game has to offer:



✅ First-person psychological horror
✅ Random mazes, no memorizing the way out
✅ Choices that shift the narrative
✅ Retro visuals with a dystopian vibe
✅ Hard mode for those who enjoy the pain
✅ Polished UI, new objectives, and more interactions
✅ 20+ achievements
✅ Full support for PT-BR and EN
✅ And yes: we’re kicking off with several livestreams so you can see even more
